findings.description: The 'How adopters can verify' section paragraph at line 42 reads: 'If a runner already has `pyyaml` / `jsonschema` importable from its preinstalled Python environment, the conditional `if ! python3 -c 'import yaml'` skip is taken, no install runs, and no hash check happens — same green-path behaviour as v1.0.0.' This paragraph was accurate for R1 (ee32abc) but is factually incorrect at R2 HEAD (4be0043): fix-round-1 SAFE-MAJ-002 closure **eliminated** the conditional `if ! python3 -c 'import yaml'` guard entirely. At R2 the install is unconditional — it always runs regardless of what the runner has preinstalled. The described skip path no longer exists. The statement 'no install runs, and no hash check happens' is now incorrect for all CI runs on the fix-round-1 branch.
findings.recommendation: Replace the paragraph at line 42 with: 'The install is **unconditional** from v1.0.1 (closes 020M R1 SAFE-MAJ-002): `pip install --require-hashes` runs on every workflow execution regardless of what the runner has preinstalled. A version-pin assertion (`assert yaml.__version__ == "6.0.2"`) follows the install and will surface any version mismatch via a SCP-E001 annotation. There is no skip path.'
